en.title: At what height is there snow in Slovakia? From 1,200 m up
en.description: At what height is there snow in Slovakia? From 1,200 m up. Snow cover, new snow, resorts and the days ahead in Slovakia on 17 November.
en.lede: Most of the ground in Slovakia is white from about 1,200 m up. Below that, the slopes are mostly green or brown.

sections.h: The height that makes the difference
p: That height is the number to compare with a resort's lifts: what matters is how much of the area lies above it.
In Slovakia, about 1,830 km² of high ground is white today, 190 km² less than yesterday. That is 10 % of the high ground we map in Slovakia.

sections.h: From the valleys to the summits
p: Climb and the snow gets deeper: between 500 and 1,000 m, under 1 cm on average, 3 % covered; between 1,000 and 1,500 m, 1 cm on average, 39 % covered; between 1,500 and 2,000 m, 9 cm on average, 99 % covered; between 2,000 and 2,500 m, 17 cm on average, 100 % covered.
Last week's 1,710 km² has grown by 120 km². Think 1,200 m and higher for a white landscape.
The deepest snow of the country's resorts is at Ski centrum Dedinky: 42 cm.
Close behind: Vernár (36 cm), Kubínská hola (27 cm), Ski Zábava Hruštín (27 cm) and Vrátna (23 cm).
At Ski centrum Dedinky: 1 cm of fresh snow over three days, 0 cm more expected by Friday 20 November.
At Vernár: 1 cm of fresh snow over three days, 0 cm more expected by Friday 20 November.
Count 34 white resorts out of 107 in Slovakia today.

The rest of the shortlist: Kubínská hola: 27 cm on top, 3 cm in three days, 3 cm expected; Ski Zábava Hruštín: 27 cm on top, 3 cm in three days, 2 cm expected; Vrátna: 23 cm on top, 7 cm in three days, 9 cm expected.
Expect up to 7 cm on the snowiest slopes by the third day; the seven-day total reaches 12 cm.
The snowiest day looks like Monday 23 November, with up to 4 cm in the snowiest spots.
In the last 72 hours the most new snow, up to 5 cm, fell over the High Tatras, the Low Tatras and Malá Fatra.
The last 24 hours alone brought up to 4 cm.
About 280 km² received at least 5 cm.

For comparison, the neighbours on the same day: Poland: 6 % white, deepest Karpacz with 36 cm, up to 12 cm in the week ahead; Czechia: 1 % white, deepest Ramzová with 21 cm, up to 7 cm in the week ahead.

sections.h: Planning a day on the snow
p: Above 1,500 m the ground is almost fully white (99 % covered), so runs up there have a continuous base.
Between 1,000 m and 1,500 m the cover is patchy, about 39 % white: expect grass and stones between the snow.
Below 1,000 m the slopes are still almost bare.
Mild weather is eating into the cover: expect firm snow in the morning and slush in the afternoon.
With more snow in the forecast, the next days should improve things further.

advice: Read the local avalanche bulletin before going off-piste.
Fresh snow on a cold base sticks badly: take care on steep slopes.
Early-season snow is thin over rocks: ski the groomed runs first.

sk.title: Sneh na Slovensku dnes: výška snehovej pokrývky a nový sneh, 17. novembra 2026
sk.description: Sneh na Slovensku 17. novembra: snehová pokrývka, nový sneh, výška podľa nadmorskej výšky, ďalšie dni a najlepšie strediská.
sk.lede: Snehová pokrývka na Slovensku zaberá asi 1 830 km² (utorok, 17. novembra). To je o 190 km² menej ako včera. To je 10 % horského územia na Slovensku, ktoré sledujeme.

p: Pred týždňom to bolo 1 710 km², pokrývka teda narástla o 120 km². Snehová hranica je okolo 1 200 m.

Výška snehu závisí od nadmorskej výšky: 500–1 000 m: priemerne pod 1 cm (3 % pod snehom); 1 000–1 500 m: priemerne 1 cm (39 % pod snehom); 1 500–2 000 m: priemerne 9 cm (99 % pod snehom); 2 000–2 500 m: priemerne 17 cm (100 % pod snehom).
Najviac nového snehu za 72 hodín: až 5 cm. Oblasti: Vysoké Tatry, Nízke Tatry a Malá Fatra.
Len za posledných 24 hodín napadlo až 4 cm.
Odmäk zjedá pokrývku: ráno tvrdý sneh, poobede mokrý.
Najviac snehu na horných tratiach: Ski centrum Dedinky, 42 cm.
Strediská so snehom na horných tratiach: 34 z 107.
Ďalej: Vernár (36 cm), Kubínská hola (27 cm), Ski Zábava Hruštín (27 cm) a Vrátna (23 cm).
Vernár: 1 cm nového snehu za tri dni a do dátumu piatok, 20. novembra ešte až 0 cm.
Počas najbližších troch dní sa čaká až 7 cm, za celý týždeň až 12 cm.
Najsnežnejší deň: pondelok, 23. novembra, až 4 cm.

advice: Nad hranicou lesa môže byť sneh nafúkaný vetrom: pozor na hrebeňoch.
Pred jazdou mimo zjazdoviek si prečítajte miestnu lavínovú predpoveď.
